## Planned measures

- INC and delivery source-record volume by date and facility
- Pregnancies with delivery evidence
- Delivery events and baby records as separate measures
- SIGIZI-only, EPUS-only, and cross-source recording coverage
- Missing delivery date, facility, outcome, and linkage indicators

## Analytical rule

A pregnancy, a delivery event, and a baby record are different grains. Counts
and percentages will identify their denominator explicitly.
